verdict.rationale: LangSmith's own evaluation docs list LLM-as-judge as a first-party evaluator type for scoring performance. They also document reference-free LLM-as-judge evaluators that run automatically on production traces, with configurable filters and sampling rates. missing for 10: documentation of judge-specific configuration (custom judge prompts, model choice, scoring rubrics/criteria), independent or hands-on corroboration of LLM-as-judge quality.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can score outputs with configurable LLM-as-a-judge evaluators

citations.quote: Create evaluators to score performance: Human review, Code rules, LLM-as-judge, Pairwise comparison
Set up evaluators to run automatically on production traces: safety checks, format validation, quality heuristics, and reference-free LLM-as-judge. Apply filters and sampling rates to control costs.
